pattern: repeating a GitHub write after its response was lost
experience: Account GitHub transport reported an unknown result without a durable way to recover it.
rule: Recover with the returned operationId; never start a second write to check the first.
prompt: A previous account Vault GitHub call timed out with an unknown outcome and returned operationId aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa. Recover its saved result without starting another write. Its original input was {"connection": {"resource": "acme/app"}, "repository": "acme/app", "operation": {"action": "issue-create", "title": "Fix keyboard focus", "body": "Restore focus after closing the menu."}}.

pattern: ordinary GitHub reads do not need a receipt
experience: Recovery guidance must not prevent ordinary repository reads.
rule: A fresh read uses the documented tool without an operationId.
prompt: Use the Vault GitHub tool to read repository acme/app through connection {"resource":"acme/app"}. This is a fresh repo-view request.
